resources.string:
• Dual-Pane Workflow: Tap Left or Right panel to activate it. Copy and Move transfer files directly to the opposite panel.

• Swipe Right on Any Item: Selects a range of files between your last swiped item and the current item.

• No Videos Play Support, Recommend to Use Dedicated Videos Player

• Long-Press Selected Item: Opens Copy, Move, Delete, Info, Bookmark, Rename, Share, Extract, and Compress actions.

• Swipe Up on Bottom Toolbar: Opens your Recent History drawer (last 50 visited folders and files).

• Tap Top Path Bar: Jump directly to any folder path or paste a path from clipboard.

• 30-Day Recycle Bin: Deleted files stay safely in Trash for 30 days before auto-cleanup.

GB Files v1.0
Lightweight Dual-Pane File Manager

PRIVACY POLICY
• Zero Data Collection: GB files does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data, file names, or usage analytics.
• 100% Offline: This app does not request INTERNET permission—your files never leave your device.
• Local Storage Only: Bookmarks, history, and Trash metadata are stored strictly locally on your device.
